lattice.comment: Type of lattice to create the initial particles (default=1)

rhopgradient.comment: Initial density gradient 1:Rhop0, 2:Water column, 3:Max. water height (default=2)

hswl.comment: Maximum height of still water to calculate speedofsound using coefsound

gamma.comment: Polytropic constant for water used in the state equation

speedsystem.comment: Maximum system speed (by default the dam-break propagation is used)

speedsound.comment: Speed of sound to use in the simulation (by default speedofsound=coefsound*speedsystem)

coefh.comment: Coefficient to calculate the smoothing length (h=coefh*sqrt(3*dp^2) in 3D)

_hdp.comment: Alternative option to calculate the smoothing length (h=hdp*dp)

maxdisth.comment: Maximum distance to boundary limit. It uses H*maxdisth (default=2)

memoryresize.comment: Initial memory resize (size0) and the following memory resizes according to initial inlet/outlet particles (default=2 and 4)

determlimit.comment: Use 1e-3 for first_order or 1e+3 for zeroth_order

refilling.comment: Refilling mode. 0:Simple full, 1:Simple below zsurf, 2:Advanced for reverse flows (very slow) (default=1)

inputtreatment.comment: Treatment of fluid entering the zone. 0:No changes, 1:Convert fluid (necessary for outlet), 2:Remove fluid (recommended for inlet)

imposevelocity.comment: Imposed velocity 0:fixed value, 1:variable value, 2:Extrapolated velocity, 3:Interpolated velocity (default=0)

meshdata.comment: Velocity data (magnitude or 3 components) from mesh-data CSV file.

magnitude.comment: Velocity data using magnitude or 3 components (default=true)

initialtime.comment: Defines the initial time of mesh data (default=0)

setpos.comment: Applies a position offset to the mesh data (default=0,0,0)

imposerhop.comment: Outlet rhop 0:Imposed fixed value, 1:Hydrostatic, 2:Extrapolated from ghost nodes (default=0)

imposezsurf.comment: Inlet Z-surface 0:Imposed fixed value, 1:Imposed variable value, 2:Calculated from fluid domain (default=0)

meshdata.comment: Zsurf data from mesh-data CSV file.

initialtime.comment: Defines the initial time of mesh data (default=0)

setpos.comment: Applies a position offset to the mesh data (default=0,0,0)

_savevtk.comment: Creates VTK files with Zsurf for each PART (default=false)

remove.comment: Removes particles above the Zsurf limit (default=false)

parameter.comment: Saves particle position using double precision (default=0)
Boundary method 1:DBC, 2:mDBC (default=1)
Step Algorithm 1:Verlet, 2:Symplectic (default=1)
Verlet only: Number of steps to apply Euler timestepping (default=40)

Multiply viscosity value with boundary (default=1)
Density Diffusion Term 0:None, 1:Molteni, 2:Fourtakas, 3:Fourtakas(full) (default=0)
DDT value (default=0.1)

Coefficient for shifting computation (default=-2)
Threshold to detect free surface. Typically 1.5 for 2D and 2.75 for 3D (default=0)
Rigid Algorithm 0:collision-free, 1:SPH, 2:DEM, 3:Chrono (default=1)
Time to freeze the floatings at simulation start (warmup) (default=0)
Ignores floating body radius with periodic conditions (default=0)
Coefficient to calculate minimum time step dtmin=coefdtmin*h/speedsound (default=0.05)
Initial time step. Use 0 to default use (default=h/speedsound)
Minimum time step. Use 0 to default use (default=coefdtmin*h/speedsound)
